```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(mgcv)
library(p8105.datasets)
```

## LIDAR data

```{r}
data("lidar")

lidar_df = 
  lidar |> 
  mutate(id = row_number()) |> 
  select(id, everything())

lidar_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = range, y = logratio)) +
  geom_point()
```

Build my training and testing datasets

```{r}
train_df = sample_frac(lidar_df, size = .8)
test_df = anti_join(lidar_df, train_df, by = "id")
```

```{r}
ggplot(train_df, aes(x = range, y = logratio)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_point(data = test_df, color = "red")
```

fit some models

```{r}
linear_mod = lm(logratio ~ range, data = train_df)
smooth_mod = gam(logratio ~ s(range), data = train_df)
wiggly_mod = gam(logratio ~ s(range, k = 30), sp = 10e-6, data = train_df)
```

make a plot

```{r}
train_df |> 
  add_predictions(linear_mod) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = range, y = logratio)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line(aes(y = pred))

```

```{r}
train_df |> 
  add_predictions(smooth_mod) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = range, y = logratio)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "red")
```

```{r}
train_df |> 
  add_predictions(wiggly_mod) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = range, y = logratio)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "red")
```

do a model comparison

```{r}
rmse(linear_mod, test_df)
rmse(smooth_mod, test_df)
rmse(wiggly_mod, test_df)
```

## Repeat a bunch of times

Use some nice tools

```{r}
cv_df = 
  crossv_mc(lidar_df, 100)

cv_df |> pull(train) |> nth(2)
```

```{r}
cv_df = 
  crossv_mc(lidar_df, 100) |> 
  mutate(
    train = map(train, as_tibble),
    test = map(test, as_tibble)
  )
```

let's fit models and get rmses for these

```{r}
rmse_comp = function(model, dataset){
  rmse(model, dataset)
}
```


```{r}
cv_df = 
  cv_df |> 
  mutate(
    linear_mod  = map(train, \(df) lm(logratio ~ range, data = df)),
    smooth_mod  = map(train, \(df) gam(logratio ~ s(range), data = df)),
    wiggly_mod  = map(train, \(df) gam(logratio ~ s(range, k = 30), sp = 10e-6, data = df))) |> 
  mutate(
    rmse_linear = map2_dbl(linear_mod, test, \(mod, df) rmse(model = mod, data = df)),
    rmse_smooth = map2_dbl(smooth_mod, test, \(mod, df) rmse(model = mod, data = df)),
    rmse_wiggly = map2_dbl(wiggly_mod, test, \(mod, df) rmse(model = mod, data = df)))
```

look at this

```{r}
cv_df |> 
  select(starts_with("rmse_")) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    everything(), 
    names_to = "model",
    names_prefix = "rmse_", 
    values_to = "rmse"
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = rmse)) +
  geom_violin()
```

## Child growth

```{r}
growth_df = 
  read_csv("data/nepalese_children.csv") |> 
  mutate(
    weight_ch7 = (weight > 7) * (weight - 7)
  )
```
look at this

```{r}
growth_df

growth_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = weight, y = armc)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5)
```

```{r}
linear_fit = lm(armc ~ weight, data = growth_df)
smooth_fit = gam(armc ~ s(weight), data = growth_df)
pwl_fit = lm(armc ~ weight + weight_ch7, data = growth_df)

growth_df |> 
  add_predictions(linear_fit) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = weight, y = armc)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "red")

growth_df |> 
  add_predictions(smooth_fit) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = weight, y = armc)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "red")

growth_df |> 
  add_predictions(pwl_fit) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = weight, y = armc)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "red")
```
